messages.text: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

Vector Network Analyzer would fit in the AI data center test workflow mainly at the high-speed electrical interconnect / PCB / PCBA signal-integrity stage: measuring IL, TDR / impedance, high-speed traces, cables, connectors, and related channel behavior for server boards, PCBs, connectors, cables, GPU/CPU or high-speed IC contexts [14][78].  
In the broader AI data center connectivity context, the relevant hardware domains include high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber, power distribution, busbar, cooling, and leak detection; VNA evidence in the passages is strongest for the high-speed electrical / interconnect and some optical-VNA SiPh/CPO-adjacent mapping, not for cooling or mechanical workflow [58][77][78].  
Workflow placement: at PCB fabricator / system house stages such as material measurement, material/stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring, where the cited measurements include impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, and impedance [67].  
At the SerDes / high-speed digital validation level, the VNA/network-analyzer role sits around transmission-channel and PI/SI validation: the source lists Tx/Rx channel elements such as packages, PCBs, connectors, and also maps Power Distribution Network testing to scopes and network analyzers [4][63].  
For R&S products specifically, the knowledge base maps R&S ZNA / ZNB to server PCB IL and TDR, connector/cable high-speed cable testing, server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace testing, GPU TDR, and optical VNA setups for SiPh [14][77][78].  
The passages do not provide a complete AI data center VNA test setup, fixture, calibration method, pass/fail criteria, frequency plan, or option configuration for these workflows [14][69][70].

answer.text:
Vector Network Analyzer would fit in the AI data center test workflow mainly at the high-speed electrical interconnect / PCB / PCBA signal-integrity stage: measuring IL, TDR / impedance, high-speed traces, cables, connectors, and related channel behavior for server boards, PCBs, connectors, cables, GPU/CPU or high-speed IC contexts [14][78].  
In the broader AI data center connectivity context, the relevant hardware domains include high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber, power distribution, busbar, cooling, and leak detection; VNA evidence in the passages is strongest for the high-speed electrical / interconnect and some optical-VNA SiPh/CPO-adjacent mapping, not for cooling or mechanical workflow [58][77][78].  
Workflow placement: at PCB fabricator / system house stages such as material measurement, material/stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring, where the cited measurements include impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, and impedance [67].  
At the SerDes / high-speed digital validation level, the VNA/network-analyzer role sits around transmission-channel and PI/SI validation: the source lists Tx/Rx channel elements such as packages, PCBs, connectors, and also maps Power Distribution Network testing to scopes and network analyzers [4][63].  
For R&S products specifically, the knowledge base maps R&S ZNA / ZNB to server PCB IL and TDR, connector/cable high-speed cable testing, server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace testing, GPU TDR, and optical VNA setups for SiPh [14][77][78].  
The passages do not provide a complete AI data center VNA test setup, fixture, calibration method, pass/fail criteria, frequency plan, or option configuration for these workflows [14][69][70].

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

R&S PCB test solutions › 可追溯限制
- 本來源沒有提供正式 R&S 產品型號、option code、license、測試頻率、測試標準、fixture 或 calibration method。
- 本頁不把 Slide 21 的圖上列名解讀為正式解決方案型錄或完整採購配置。
- [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]] 的角色未明，僅保留圖上列名。
- [[ISD-ADK]] 與 PL 未展開縮寫，需後續來源補證。

R&S PCB test solutions › 未決事項
- Slide 21 未標示 R&S PCB test solutions 的正式文件版次與產品 portfolio 對應。
- Slide 21 未標示 [[TDR]]、[[Delta-L]]、ISD/ADK、DK/DF extraction 的標準版本、演算法、測試條件或工具型號。
- Slide 21 未展開 PL、ISD、ADK、RSTW、SWISSTO12、QWED、KEYCOM。
- 需回看原始 PPTX 圖像確認各圖示、商標、箭頭與工具對應關係。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › Optical / SiPh / CPO
- [[矽光子]]欄將 optical VNA 對應到 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] + PSA with [[ThinkLands]]，以及 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] + [[GOCA]] with [[Newkey]]。
- 來源角色亮點稱 [[CPO]] 對有源 / 無源 [[SiPh]]、先進封裝與測試需求大幅提升，並稱 [[前鼎]]提供高速載板給矽光子模組與 CPO 元件、[[光聖]]提供 ELS 外部雷射源。
- 這些說法都只追溯到 [[AISeverEcosystem]]，不等同於量產、採購、出貨或 R&S formal application note。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › SI / high-speed channel / interconnect
- [[R&S ZNA]] 與 [[R&S ZNB]] 在來源中被放入 [[伺服器電路板]] / [[PCB]] 的 IL、TDR，以及 [[連接器]] / 線纜的 high speed cable 測試。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 也出現在 [[伺服器主機板]] / PCBA 的 high speed trace test、[[GPU]] 的 TDR、[[CPU]]、[[智原]]、[[譜瑞-KY]]等 IC / high-speed transmission context。
- [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 出現在 [[智原]] 與 [[旺矽]] 的 solution 欄，但來源未提供實際 frequency range 或 fixture。
